item.title: Argon Medical Devices, Inc: General Biospy Tray, REF: GUTS1000 Recall
item.summary: Kits containing Lidocaine HCL Injection USP 1% 10mg/mL 5mL ampules subject to another recall recalled due to not meeting release criteria for sterility. Product details: General Biospy Tray, REF: GUTS1000
item.affectedPeople: Distribution US nationwide including Puerto Rico; OUS to Trinidad and Tobago.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
